title: Strike off a company from the register (DS01)
text:
Important: before you apply to strike off your company

 You have certain responsibilities to close down your business properly .

 The company’s bank account will be frozen from the date of dissolution.

 Any credit balance in the account and other assets will pass to the Crown - you’ll have to restore the company to get anything back.

 See our guidance on company strike off and dissolution .

 How to apply

 You should only send a paper form DS01 if you cannot apply to strike off a company online .

 It costs £13 to apply online. You can pay the fee using a debit or credit card.

 A paper application costs £18 and you can only pay by cheque or postal order.

 It usually takes much longer to process paper documents sent by post.
